role: ONE bounded action-conditioned dual-eye visual motion forecast increment, not M3 physics fit, depth estimator or full navigation worldmodel
input: current/past compressed binocular image-derived flow, current native IMU/encoder measured joints, current known issued request and previous request; no future feedback/applied/GTdepth/GTpose
features: 14 current sensor/request features + normalized queryXY(2) + XY products(3) + current/past image flow(2) + prior-flow-valid(1) + eyeID(1); no absolute scene/world coordinates
candidate: one train-only scaled L2 ridge residual next image-flow predictor alpha1, no hyperparameter scan, no alternate model after failure
baseline: last available image flow continued, otherwise zero; same teacher queries and whole sequence coverage
teacher: offline current->next recorded image LK21/3/30/.01/FB1/error20; inside image and fixedCAD excluded, unavailable unknown; approximate 2D correspondence not true3D/occupied/free
fit_weight: per-frame total1 shared eyes, train only; evaluate moving and all frames separately
moving_definition: current abs(main_encoder)>.05rad/s OR current native gyro norm>.05rad/s, defined before fresh
on_failure: reject sole forecast candidate; no extra network/refit/threshold scan, preserve all old and fresh results
on_pass: forecast layer only; no navigation admission; at most two readonly online shadow sequences with predictions sealed before next feedback/teacher, no controller change
